title: feat(auth): surface key management link on 403 model permissions
author: fisventurous
pr_body_excerpt:
surfaces key management URL when requests fail due to model permission limits

closes #14814

\- append `https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys` to 403 error in gateway `requireModelAccess`
\- append same key management link to 403 error in realtime route `requireAllowedModel`
\- update gateway model permissions tests for new error message format
\- surface key management link in MCP `parseApiError` 403 handler without duplicating if already present
\- add unit tests for MCP 403 error parsing

gist.headline: 403s Know Where to Go
gist.blurb: Permission errors now leave a little trail back to the key garden. If a model is outside a key’s access, the API and MCP point directly to key management instead of making you forage for it.
gist.summary: 403 model-permission errors from the gateway, realtime route, and MCP now include https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys, with MCP avoiding duplicate links when the gateway already supplied one.
gist.impact: Developers whose API key lacks access to a requested model can go straight from the 403 response to key management and update access without hunting through the dashboard.
gist.visual_concept: A friendly signpost or garden path represents the new actionable 403 response, leading from a politely locked model gate to the key-management kiosk. Polli, wearing a tiny locksmith tool belt, points the way while the eager CRT robot reads an error slip; code-plants and flowers make the access-control scene feel helpful rather than blocked.
